solutionReview.headline: "At least" is $\ge$ and "at most" is $\le$.
reasoning: The number of tickets is $x+y$; "at least {{nmin}}" means $x+y\ge {{nmin}}$.
The money collected is ${{a}}x+{{s}}y$ dollars; "at most {{budget}}" means ${{a}}x+{{s}}y\le {{budget}}$.
So the system is $x+y\ge {{nmin}}$ and ${{a}}x+{{s}}y\le {{budget}}$.
solutionReview.commonError: Writing equations instead of inequalities, or flipping one of the symbols: "at least" sets a floor, "at most" a ceiling.
